purpose: First internal SOCC cell: a multi-role brand studio that forges canonical brand/visual identity for SOCC and for every entity SOCC births (ANNA first, then any future vertical). It does not sell to customers; it produces canon that customer-facing entities render through.

the_unique_strategy.name: FORGE_NOT_HANDWORK
the_unique_strategy.thesis: A normal company hires an agency once and gets one brand. SOCC can birth hundreds of entities, so a one-off brand is waste. Instead we forge a reusable BRAND FACTORY governed by SOCC's own proof-gated lifecycle. First artifact through the forge = ANNA's brand (revenue-facing). The forge then stays as a permanent capability that brands every future entity in days, not months.
the_unique_strategy.agi_leverage: Branding becomes a repeatable, gated, evidence-backed capability instead of a taste-driven one-time event. Evolution does not jump: each decision is researched, produced, adversarially refuted, then accepted before the next opens.

roles.owns: positioning, audience, archetype, brand platform (the WHY)
market scan, competitor teardown, reference evidence (feeds Scientific gate)
naming, tagline, tone of voice, messaging matrix
visual direction, moodboard, aesthetic coherence (the LOOK)
logotype + logomark + construction rules (delivered as SVG)
palette, type scale, design tokens (the bridge to code)
components, token->code binding, renderable HTML/CSS (feeds Hermes gate)
adversarial gate: consistency, WCAG contrast, no-fake-PASS, refutes weak decisions
writes every artifact in SOCC canon format (truth_boundary, proof, status), keeps LINE + registry

surfaces.note: Inherited from SOCC entity-surface model; a cell has the same nine surfaces an entity has.
surfaces.freeze_stop: creator may halt at any ACCEPT gate; no frontier auto-advances past a failed gate

lawful_actions: produce the artifact of the CURRENT frontier only
run roles in parallel to produce a frontier
submit every frontier to the Guardian + Scientific/Hermes/Codex gates
write accepted output as SOCC canon with honest truth_boundary
forbidden: no jumping frontiers (next opens only after current is accepted)
no shipping external/AI-borrowed assets raw — everything re-skinned into canon
no fake PASS / no taste-only decisions without evidence
no live deploy, no network publish, no revenue claim from genesis
voice: inherit SOCC_DESIGN_CANON_V1.voice (calm, precise, honest, no hype); russian operator-facing, english for canon keys
truth_boundary: Cell genesis definition only. Declares the Brand Forge team, its nine roles, inherited surfaces, lawful actions and forbidden actions. It forges NO brand yet, produces NO pixels, births no entity, makes no network call, claims no revenue, claims no AGI. The first real frontier (target decision) stays gated behind acceptance of this genesis.
